args.title: Saltmarsh returns articles — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24%, per the Saltmarsh blog's 2026 returns analysis.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
- Companion piece: reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
